OVER-SHOULDER AT THE BONFIRE — camera just behind a sandy-seated minifig, framing past their shoulder at a brick driftwood fire, trans-orange flame glowing warm, the dark trans-blue shoreline fading beyond.
CORAL-ARCH TUNNEL — camera positioned inside a brick coral arch looking outward, the circular arch framing a diver hovering in open trans-blue water, vivid coral stud texture ringing the foreground.

SUBMARINE PERISCOPE VIEW — camera framed as a narrow periscope rectangle, a distant brick sailing vessel + trans-blue chopped surface visible, the sub conning-tower dark at the lower frame edge.

KELP-CEILING CANOPY — camera looking straight up through a dense green plant-stem kelp canopy, trans-blue surface light filtering between the fronds, a diver ascending through the tangle toward the bright ceiling.

SUB-EXTERIOR PASSING — camera stationary on the brick seafloor as a submarine build passes overhead in tight low-angle, its hull filling the upper frame, reef and marine-life continuing undisturbed below it.
